hook.visual: Red 504 Gateway Timeout error screen on laptop.
hook.spoken_text: Running a standard CREATE INDEX query in Postgres can freeze your entire app.

scenes.visual: Database monitoring graph with query queue spiking.
scenes.spoken_text: Postgres acquires an exclusive table lock, halting every incoming customer write until the index build completes.

scenes.visual: Terminal showing CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY running without blocking.
scenes.spoken_text: Instead, pass the CONCURRENTLY keyword outside of a transaction block. Postgres builds the index in the background while writes continue.

scenes.visual: Clean syntax card with final SQL command highlighted.
scenes.spoken_text: Save this command before your next deployment, and check the description for the full zero downtime migration checklist.
